$(f \circ g^{-1})^{-1} = g \circ f^{-1}$이므로 $(f \circ g^{-1})^{-1}(r) = (g \circ f^{-1})(r) = g(f^{-1}(r))$ $f(s) = r$이므로 $f^{-1}(r) = s \implies g(s) = t$ 또 $g(s) = t$이므로 $g^{-1}(t) = s \implies (f \circ g^{-1})(t) = f(s) = r$ $\therefore (f \circ g^{-1})^{-1}(r) + (f \circ g^{-1})(t) = t + r$.
